translated_title: The Social Sector of the Economy: The Missing Piece Facing the Market
original_title: El sector social de la economía: la pieza que falta frente al mercado
author: Óscar David Rojas Silva
meta_description: "The social sector represents all those forms that do not compulsively pursue the objectives of the capitalist economy. They have as their antecedent all the community and cooperative forms that have not been able to be subsumed under the logic of profit"
